pages.title: The Lumberjack’s Lunch
pages.text: Feeding Relicheirus earns forestry help without invented taming.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Relicheirus temporarily fells trees after soup; this is a service, not taming. Tree Stars breed it. Drinking the soup yourself also provides Haste.
